definition: A change to the minimum, maximum, or span of a salary range.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 12 distinct documented salary range change implementation events across 12 municipalities in 5 states. A change to the minimum, maximum, or span of a salary range. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
